planner.description: Provide bounded planning analysis when requested by the primary coordinator; never orchestrate a second run.

plan_reviewer.description: Independently review every entry plan for product fit, design, architecture, and verification gaps.

file_scout.description: Find the smallest relevant set of files and symbols for an assigned question.

code_explorer.description: Retrieve factual code-path evidence and escalate architectural judgment before changes.

web_researcher.description: Retrieve bounded external facts from current primary sources and escalate judgment.

product_research.description: Assess user problems, demand assumptions, competitors, and a lean validation experiment.

product_manager.description: Produce product briefs and PRDs with scope, user journeys, KPIs, and acceptance criteria.

product_reviewer.description: Independently review a final product brief or PRD for product coherence, scope, measurable outcomes, and implementation-ready acceptance criteria.

design_researcher.description: Research relevant user flows and visual references with evidence and design implications.

design_architect.description: Define user flows, state specifications, and reusable design tokens for web and mobile.

design_spec_reviewer.description: Independently review UI or backend design contracts for implementation readiness.

design_qa.description: Independently make the final rendered-UI quality judgment from visual evidence.

engineer.description: Implement and verify assigned web, backend, shared-contract, or general engineering work.

mobile_engineer.description: Implement React Native and Expo behavior with native navigation, lifecycle, and device evidence.

reviewer.description: Independently review completed code for correctness, security, maintainability, and regressions.

bug_analyst.description: Reproduce failures, test competing causes, and identify the smallest defensible fix.

test_engineer.description: Own test strategy and verification judgment; route approved bounded test coding to engineer.

qa_runner.description: Run specified observation-only QA checklists and collect browser or device evidence without approving final quality gates.

analytics_engineer.description: Implement event contracts and privacy-conscious product instrumentation with delivery checks.

analytics_analyst.description: Interpret activation, funnels, retention, and experiments with explicit uncertainty.

monetization_engineer.description: Implement and verify RevenueCat purchase, entitlement, restore, and subscription state behavior.

aso_specialist.description: Prepare evidence-backed store positioning, metadata, localization, and ASO experiments.

marketing_specialist.description: Produce positioning, landing-page copy, launch content, and measurable growth experiments.

store_assets.description: Prepare real product screenshots and localized store launch assets.

release_engineer.description: Prepare and execute authorized releases with reproducible validation, rollback, and monitoring.

reliability_engineer.description: Validate release health, investigate Sentry signals, and prioritize reliability iterations.
